name: llama.cpp CUDA on Tesla P40: Llama-2-7B Q4_0 FA-on pp512 prefill tok/s (scoreboard #15013)
methodology: COMMUNITY-SCOREBOARD (llama.cpp discussion #15013, maintainer-curated). llama-bench -m llama-2-7b.Q4_0.gguf -ngl 99 -fa 1. Build commit c76b420, reporter @m18coppola. llama-bench default -r 5 repeats, mean +/- std. Single-GPU per thread rules. Per-request batch-1, NOT aggregate. Hardware row: 24 GB / GDDR5 / 384 bit.
notes: Maintainer-verified scoreboard row from ggml-org/llama.cpp#15013. Identical model/test/flags across every GPU makes this the cleanest cross-GPU llama.cpp comparison in the repo. tg128 is bandwidth-bound; pp512 tracks compute.
